desc: The WPMR Google Feed Manager for WooCommerce – Sell on Google Merchant Center & Shopping plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to generic SQL Injection via the 'sourceId' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 2.24.1 due to insufficient escaping on the user supplied parameter and lack of sufficient preparation on the existing SQL query. title: Improper access control in the administrative role assignment endpoint in Devolutions Server 2026.3.13.0 and earlier all
desc: Improper access control in the administrative role assignment endpoint in Devolutions Server 2026.3.13.0 and earlier allows an authenticated user with only vault assignment management rights to escalate privileges and read vault entry passwords via a crafted role assignment request.

desc: Improper access control in the connection history in Devolutions Server 2026.3.13.0 allows an authenticated user without the permission to view passwords to obtain historical entry passwords via the connection history API.

title: Insertion of sensitive information into sent data in the user endpoints in Devolutions Server 2026.3.13.0 and earlier al
desc: Insertion of sensitive information into sent data in the user endpoints in Devolutions Server 2026.3.13.0 and earlier allows an authenticated user with delegated user-viewing permissions to obtain users' MFA shared secrets via the user API responses.

title: Insertion of sensitive information into sent data in the user list endpoint in Devolutions Server 2026.3.13.0 and earlie
desc: Insertion of sensitive information into sent data in the user list endpoint in Devolutions Server 2026.3.13.0 and earlier allows an authenticated user with delegated user-viewing permissions to obtain users' API key secret hashes via the user list API response.

title: Improper access control in the autofill vault search in Devolutions Server 2026.3.13.0 and earlier allows an authenticat
desc: Improper access control in the autofill vault search in Devolutions Server 2026.3.13.0 and earlier allows an authenticated user with only view permission on a shared entry to obtain its password in clear text via a linked credential entry created in their private vault.

title: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 SQL Injection via CCR revandapprove Field Names
desc: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains an sql injection vulnerability that allows any authenticated core user to inject SQL by supplying crafted patient_data field names to the CCR revandapprove controller. title: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 Missing Authorization in Procedure Order Form
desc: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in interface/forms/procedure_order/common.php that allows authenticated accounts lacking patients/lab permission to read and modify other patients' procedure orders. Attackers can request a global order id to disclose clinical history, or select the target patient in their session and submit bn_save to falsify diagnoses, instructi

title: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 Missing Authorization via create_portallogin.php Portal Takeover
desc: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in create_portallogin.php that allows low-privilege authenticated users to replace patient portal credentials without ACL checks. Attackers can select a victim patient in session and post replacement credentials to take over portal accounts, read PHI, and lock patients out.

title: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 Missing Authorization via destroyed_drugs_report.php
desc: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows any authenticated core user to retrieve destroyed-drug records because destroyed_drugs_report.php lacks the admin/drugs or inventory/reporting ACL check. Attackers can submit the report refresh form with a chosen date range to obtain drug names, NDC, lots, quantities, destruction methods, witnesses, and notes.

title: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 Stored XSS via Patient External ID in Prescriptions
desc: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows authenticated users to inject scripts by placing payloads in the patient External ID field. The payload executes when other users open the patient's prescriptions via View Printable Version (HTML), running script in their browser sessions.

title: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 TOTP Brute Force via main_screen.php and OAuth2
desc: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 lacks rate limiting or lockout on TOTP submission, allowing attackers with a valid password to brute-force the 6-digit MFA code. Attackers can script repeated POST requests to main_screen.php or the OAuth2 authorization flow with re-submitted hidden credentials to bypass two-factor authentication.

title: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 Missing Authorization via authorizations_full.php
desc: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in authorizations_full.php that allows any authenticated staff user to authorize arbitrary patients' clinical records. Attackers can send a mode=authorize request with an attacker-chosen pid and their own CSRF token to set authorized=1 on billing, forms, pnotes, and transactions records, bypassing provider review.

title: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 SQL Injection via billing parser, reports, Zend modules
desc: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains multiple sql injection vulnerabilities that allow authenticated users to inject payloads through ERA CLP01, form_facility, form_icd_codes, and POST key names. Attackers can perform UNION, blind, and error-based injection to read users_secure password hashes and patient PHI, and overwrite patient_data fields.

title: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 Missing Authorization via print_referral.php and trend_form.php
desc: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in print_referral.php and trend_form.php that allows low-privileged Front Office users to access patient PHI without patients:med permission. Attackers can directly request these endpoints with arbitrary patient_id values to retrieve patient demographics, insurance data, and vitals history, enumerating IDs to expand disclosure.

title: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 Reflected XSS via searchEleNo in Auto-Suggest Endpoint
desc: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a reflected cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows authenticated attackers to execute JavaScript by injecting payloads into the searchEleNo POST parameter of the application/index/search endpoint. Attackers can break out of unencoded HTML attributes in auto-suggest.phtml to inject event handlers that fire on DOM insertion, stealing non-HttpOnly session cookies

title: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 Missing Authorization in Module Manager Installer Actions
desc: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in five Module Manager InstallerController actions that lack the admin/manage_modules ACL check and CSRF validation. Low-privilege users such as Front Office accounts can POST to saveConfig or SaveHooks to overwrite any module's configuration, retarget CCDA and HIE settings, and delete module hooks.

title: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 SQL Injection via form_facility in ippf_statistics.php
desc: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains an SQL injection vulnerability that allows authenticated report users to manipulate queries by supplying a crafted form_facility value to interface/reports/ippf_statistics.php. Attackers can close the string literal in the facility_id WHERE clause and use boolean or time-based payloads to read sensitive database contents.

title: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 Global Configuration Override via user_settings.php
desc: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated users to override system-wide global configuration values by storing global-prefixed keys through library/ajax/user_settings.php. Attackers can submit lab or target parameters with global: prefixed setting names to disable audit logging, weaken password policies, or alter security-sensitive settings persi

title: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 SQL Injection via getByPatientDemographics in patient.inc.php
desc: OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a stored SQL injection vulnerability in getByPatientDemographics() where layout_options field_id values are concatenated into the patient search WHERE clause. Attackers with Layout Editor access can plant a malicious field_id, allowing any authenticated low-privilege user to exfiltrate data from patient_data and users_secure tables.

title: Zipline before 4.7.0 Race Condition in Invite and Quota Limits
desc: Zipline before 4.7.0 contains a race condition vulnerability that allows users to bypass invitation usage limits, upload storage quotas, and shortened-URL quotas through concurrent requests. Attackers can send overlapping registration, upload, or URL creation requests that pass checks against stale state, creating extra accounts and exceeding administrator-configured resource quotas.

title: Contiki-NG through 5.2 Out-of-Bounds Read via CoAP Observe URI Matching
desc: Contiki-NG through 5.2 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in coap_remove_observer_by_uri() that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to read past the supplied URI buffer. Attackers can send a CoAP GET Observe request with a Uri-Path shorter than an existing observer's URL, causing memcmp with strlen to read beyond the non-NUL-terminated buffer.

title: OpenFunction through 1.2.0 NULL Pointer Dereference DoS via Serving Controller
desc: OpenFunction through 1.2.0 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in getServingRun that allows users permitted to create Serving resources to crash the operator by omitting the triggers section. Attackers can submit a Serving with nil Spec.Triggers to crash-loop the controller-manager, halting Function and Serving reconciliation cluster-wide until the object is deleted.

title: phpMyFAQ 4.0.12 through 4.0.19, 4.1.x before 4.1.12 and 4.2.0 pre-releases Stored XSS via Top-Ten Title
desc: phpMyFAQ 4.0.12 through 4.0.19, 4.1.x before 4.1.12, and 4.2.0 pre-releases before 4.2.0-RC.1 contain a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in startpage.twig, where top-ten FAQ titles are rendered with Twig's raw filter. Authenticated users with FAQ edit permission can save a question containing a double quote and event handler, which runs script for every start page visitor.

title: FusionPBX through 5.6.5 Path Traversal via Fax Email Attachment Filename
desc: FusionPBX through 5.6.5 contains a path traversal vulnerability in app/fax/fax_emails.php that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to write files by using a crafted MIME attachment filename. Attackers can email the polled fax mailbox with a spoofed authorized From address and use ../ sequences in the filename to create or overwrite web-server-writable files with .pdf/.tif content.

desc: A cross-site request forgery vulnerability in tracker-invocation.php in Revive Adserver 6.0.8 and earlier allows an attacker to modify a tracker's name, description or advertiser assignment using an authenticated victim's permissions. desc: An authorization bypass in channel-edit.php in Revive Adserver 6.0.8 and earlier allows an authenticated manager to create a delivery rule set belonging to another agency by changing the submitted agencyid parameter. desc: Dell PowerScale InsightIQ, versions 6.3.0 through 6.4.0, containsan Insertion of Sensitive Information into Log File vulnerability. A low privileged attacker with remote access could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to Information disclosure.

desc: Dell PowerScale InsightIQ, versions 6.3.0 through 6.4.0, contains a Missing Authorization vulnerability. A low privileged attacker with remote access could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to Unauthorized access.

desc: A authentication bypass by spoofing vulnerability in Fortinet FortiAnalyzer 8.0.0 through 8.0.1, FortiAnalyzer 7.6.0 through 7.6.7, FortiAnalyzer 7.4.0 through 7.4.11, FortiAnalyzer 7.2.0 through 7.2.12, FortiAnalyzer Cloud 8.0.1, FortiAnalyzer Cloud 7.6.0 through 7.6.7, FortiAnalyzer Cloud 7.4.1 through 7.4.11, FortiAnalyzer Cloud 7.2.1 through 7.2.12, FortiAnalyzer-BigData 7.6.0 through 7.6.2, F

title: Zipline before 4.6.4 Rate Limit Bypass via Query String and Header
desc: Zipline before 4.6.4 contains a rate limit bypass vulnerability that allows remote attackers to evade request limits by varying query strings or supplying the x-zipline-p-filename header. Attackers can append differing query parameters to login and file or short-link password verification endpoints to perform credential guessing beyond the intended rate limits.

title: Zipline before 4.6.1 Path Traversal via Imported Filenames in LocalDatasource
desc: Zipline before 4.6.1 contains a path traversal vulnerability in LocalDatasource that allows SUPERADMIN users to read or delete files outside the upload directory by importing records with traversal filenames. Attackers can trigger the unchecked range-read path with byte-range requests or set expired deletion times to delete files accessible to the Zipline process.

title: Zipline through 4.4.0 Path Traversal Arbitrary File Delete via x-zipline-file-extension
desc: Zipline through 4.4.0 contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows authenticated attackers to delete arbitrary server files by injecting traversal sequences via the x-zipline-file-extension header. Attackers can upload a file with a poisoned stored name and short expiry so LocalDatasource deletion removes chosen files, causing denial of service or data loss.

title: OpsTree BuildPiper before 2.7.0 Path Traversal via Additional Manifest Rendering
desc: OpsTree BuildPiper before 2.7.0 contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows authenticated users to read arbitrary files by supplying traversal sequences in Additional Manifest file paths. Attackers can enter paths like ../../../../etc/passwd so the renderer embeds file contents in generated manifests and logs, exposing configuration files and service-account tokens.

title: OpsTree BuildPiper before 2.7.0 OTP Brute Force via password_reset/check_otp
desc: OpsTree BuildPiper before 2.7.0 lacks rate limiting on password-reset OTP verification, allowing unauthenticated attackers to brute force 6-digit OTPs. Attackers can initiate a reset and submit unthrottled guesses to the check_otp endpoint, resetting the target's password and taking over the account.

title: Huginn from 2026.09.09 before 2026.11.09 SSRF via OUTBOUND_PROXY Bypass
desc: Huginn from 2026.09.09 before 2026.11.09 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability because OutboundProxy.configure! applies the egress proxy only to Faraday and Typhoeus. Authenticated users can configure JiraAgent or WeiboPublishAgent to send HTTParty, open-uri or Net::HTTP requests directly to internal services, with JiraAgent returning response data as events.

title: Ryot before 10.5.6 Authorization Bypass via revokeAccessLink GraphQL Mutation
desc: Ryot before 10.5.6 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated users to revoke other users' access links by supplying an arbitrary accessLinkId. Attackers can obtain access link ids from public share URLs and revoke them without ownership checks, breaking shared access for all link users.

title: BuildAdmin 1.0.1 through 2.3.9 Stored XSS via X-Rewrite-URL in Admin Log
desc: BuildAdmin 1.0.1 through 2.3.9 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to store javascript: URLs in the admin operation log via the X-Rewrite-URL header. When an administrator clicks the log entry's url open button, the script runs in the backend origin and steals the adminInfo token from localStorage, enabling account takeover.

title: AIP-PUB ACPs-community verify-code Endpoint service_auth.py send_verification_code improper authentication
desc: A weakness has been identified in AIP-PUB ACPs-community up to 2.2.0. The impacted element is the function send_verification_code of the file registry-server/app/account/service_auth.py of the component verify-code Endpoint. Executing a manipulation of the argument phone can lead to improper authentication. The attack can be launched remotely. The exploit has been made available to the public and

title: SourceCodester Food Ordering System Admin Image update_food.php unrestricted upload
desc: A vulnerability was identified in SourceCodester Food Ordering System 1.0. Affected by this issue is some unknown functionality of the file admin/update_food.php of the component Admin Image Handler. Such manipulation of the argument cmd leads to unrestricted upload. The attack may be performed from remote. The exploit is publicly available and might be used.

title: FrankenPHP before 1.13.4 Use-After-Free via putenv() During Request Shutdown
desc: FrankenPHP before 1.13.4 contains a use-after-free vulnerability that leaves a dangling pointer to a freed environment table when putenv() is called during request shutdown. Attackers triggering putenv() in shutdown functions, destructors, or session handlers can crash the process on the next getenv() call or leak previous request environment values.

title: FrankenPHP before 1.13.4 Information Disclosure via Per-Request Environment Variable Leak
desc: FrankenPHP before 1.13.4 contains an information disclosure vulnerability in worker mode that leaks per-request environment variables into later requests on the same PHP thread. Attackers can read values set via env directives with request placeholders or WithRequestEnv() through getenv() or $_SERVER, causing applications to act on another user's routing, tenant, or authorization values.

title: FrankenPHP before 1.13.0 Authentication Bypass via Dot-Form Header Name Aliasing
desc: FrankenPHP before 1.13.0 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to spoof trusted headers by sending dot-form header names that PHP rewrites to underscores. Attackers can send headers like X.Authenticated.User or X.Forwarded.For that map to $_SERVER keys, spoofing user identity, client IP, or scheme.

title: FrankenPHP before 1.1.11 Delayed Propagation of Base Image Security Fixes
desc: FrankenPHP Docker images before 1.1.11 were rebuilt only when new base image tags were created, so security fixes that Alpine, PHP, and Go applied under existing tags were not propagated. Remote attackers could exploit known flaws in the stale system libraries, such as CVE-2025-15467 in libcrypto3, to execute code.

title: OpenMage magento-lts before 20.18.2 Incorrect Authorization in Admin Controllers ACL
desc: OpenMage magento-lts before 20.18.2 and 21.0.0-beta1 before 21.0.0-beta3 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability because admin controllers' _isAllowed() checks fall back to, or only check, parent ACL resources instead of finer per-action permissions. Authenticated restricted administrators can mass cancel or hold orders, rewrite order shipping addresses, export customer report data, or c

title: OpenMage Magento-LTS before 20.18.2 Authorization Bypass via Forgeable RSS Order Key
desc: OpenMage Magento-LTS before 20.18.2 and 21.0.0-beta1 before 21.0.0-beta3 contains an authorization bypass in the /rss/order/status feed because its URL key is unsigned Base64-encoded JSON of the order, increment, and customer ids. Unauthenticated attackers can forge keys from enumerated sequential ids to read other customers' names, items, prices, totals, and status comments when order-status RSS

title: OpenMage Magento LTS before 20.18.2 CSRF via OAuth Authorization Confirm
desc: OpenMage Magento LTS before 20.18.2 and 21.0.0-beta1 before 21.0.0-beta3 contains a cross-site request forgery vulnerability in the admin and storefront OAuth confirm and confirmSimple actions, which accept GET requests without form-key validation. Attackers holding OAuth consumer credentials can lure a logged-in administrator or customer to a crafted confirm URL that authorizes the attacker's req

title: Scapy before 2.8.0 Denial of Service via Quadratic BER OID Decoding
desc: Scapy before 2.8.0 contains a denial of service vulnerability in BER_num_dec() and BERcodec_OID.do_dec() that allows remote attackers to exhaust CPU by supplying oversized OID arcs. Attackers can send ASN.1/BER data with many base-128 continuation bytes to cause quadratic CPU consumption or an uncaught ValueError crash on Python 3.11+.

title: libexpat xmlwf through 2.10.0 Symlink Following via -d Output Directory
desc: The xmlwf tool in libexpat through 2.10.0 contains a symlink following vulnerability because -d output mode opens files with fopen("wb"), which follows symbolic links. Local attackers with write access to the output directory can plant a symlink at the expected output name to truncate or overwrite files writable by the xmlwf user.

title: Miniflux before 2.3.5 Insufficient Session Expiration After Password Change
desc: Miniflux before 2.3.5 contains an insufficient session expiration vulnerability that allows attackers to retain account access because password changes do not revoke existing web sessions. Attackers holding a leaked password or copied session cookie keep access for up to 30 days, reading integration credentials, creating API keys, or registering passkeys.

title: listmonk 6.2.0 before 7.0.0-beta.2 Missing Authentication via Azure Bounce Webhook
desc: listmonk 6.2.0 before 7.0.0-beta.2 contains a missing authentication vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to submit Azure Event Grid bounce webhooks when no shared secret is configured. Attackers can POST forged EmailDeliveryReportReceived events with Bounced status to /webhooks/service/azure to blocklist, unsubscribe, or delete arbitrary subscribers.

title: ExcelJS through 4.4.0 Memory Exhaustion via Unbounded Worksheet Column Range
desc: exceljs through 4.4.0 contains a memory exhaustion vulnerability that allows attackers to crash applications by supplying a worksheet col element with an unbounded max attribute. Attackers can craft a small workbook with a huge max value, causing xlsx.load() to allocate hundreds of millions of Column objects and abort the process with an uncatchable heap out-of-memory error.

title: ExcelJS through 4.4.0 Denial of Service via Oversized Worksheet sheetId
desc: ExcelJS through 4.4.0 contains a denial of service vulnerability that allows attackers to block the event loop by supplying an unbounded sheetId in xl/workbook.xml. Attackers can provide a workbook with a huge sheetId, making the sparse worksheet array walk stall worksheets, getWorksheet and writeBuffer for seconds.

title: ExcelJS through 4.4.0 Resource Exhaustion via Streaming WorkbookReader Temporary Files
desc: ExcelJS through 4.4.0 contains a resource leak vulnerability in the streaming WorkbookReader.parse that leaves temporary files and open descriptors when sheet parsing fails or iteration stops early. Attackers can repeatedly upload malformed multi-sheet workbooks with worksheets placed before xl/sharedStrings.xml to fill the temporary directory and exhaust file descriptors.

title: AdminNeo before 5.9.1 Stored HTML Injection via Column Type Help Popup
desc: AdminNeo before 5.9.1 contains a stored HTML injection vulnerability that allows database users to inject markup into another user's session via column type names rendered with innerHTML. Attackers can create a PostgreSQL type or table with markup in its name to render live elements in the help popup, enabling content spoofing and requests to attacker servers.

title: AdminNeo before 5.9.1 Stored XSS via printTablePartitions Partition Expression
desc: AdminNeo before 5.9.1 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in Admin::printTablePartitions() that allows authenticated users to inject HTML by placing markup in partition column names. Attackers with CREATE or ALTER privileges can create a partitioned table whose unescaped partition expression executes script when another user opens the table-structure page.

title: phpMyFAQ 4.1.0 before 4.1.12 and 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-RC.2 Category ACL Bypass
desc: phpMyFAQ 4.1.0 before 4.1.12 and 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-RC.2 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that exposes restricted and inactive category metadata to unauthenticated visitors. Attackers can enumerate category IDs via /category/{id}/{slug}.html or query /api/v4.0/categories to read names, descriptions, images and FAQ counts of restricted categories.

title: phpMyFAQ before 4.1.12 and 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-RC.2 Private Notes Disclosure via FAQ API
desc: phpMyFAQ before 4.1.12 and 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-RC.2 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to read editor-only Private Notes by querying the public FAQ list API. Attackers can page through GET /api/v4.0/faqs or /api/v3.1/faqs without credentials to retrieve the notes field of every anonymously readable FAQ, exposing internal remarks and ticket d

title: phpMyFAQ 4.2.0-alpha.2 before 4.2.0-RC.2 Authorization Bypass via /admin/api/faq/update
desc: phpMyFAQ from 4.2.0-alpha.2 before 4.2.0-RC.2 contains an authorization bypass that lets category- or language-restricted editors rewrite visibility ACLs and tags of any FAQ. Attackers send faq/update requests with a target faqId and an untranslated lang to expose restricted FAQs, wipe tags, or overwrite orphaned FAQs.

title: AdminNeo before 5.9.1 Reflected XSS via REQUEST_URI in EditorNeo Whisper Script
desc: AdminNeo before 5.9.1 contains a reflected cross-site scripting vulnerability in EditorNeo that allows remote attackers to execute JavaScript by injecting quote characters into the request URI. Attackers can lure authenticated users to crafted edit links whose path breaks out of the CSP-nonced whisper script in editor/core/Admin.php, enabling session theft and database credential disclosure.

title: AdminNeo before 5.9.1 Reflected HTML Injection via where Parameter Keys
desc: AdminNeo before 5.9.1 contains a reflected HTML injection vulnerability that allows remote attackers to inject markup by supplying crafted array keys in the where URL parameter. Attackers can trick logged-in users into opening a link whose unescaped keys land in select search form name attributes, enabling meta refresh redirects and content spoofing.

title: phpMyFAQ 4.1.9 before 4.1.12 and 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-RC.2 Brute Force via /admin/password/update
desc: phpMyFAQ 4.1.9 before 4.1.12 and 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-RC.2 contains an improper restriction of excessive authentication attempts vulnerability in PasswordChangeController::update() that bypasses the step-up throttle. Attackers holding a hijacked admin-area session can repeatedly guess faqpassword_old with a reusable CSRF token to learn the original password and take over the account.

title: AdminNeo before 5.9.1 Open Redirect via Referer in Edit Form
desc: AdminNeo before 5.9.1 contains an open redirect vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to redirect authenticated users by injecting an external URL through the HTTP Referer header into the hidden referer field of the edit form. Attackers can lure users from a page with an unsafe-url referrer policy whose URL contains &select=, redirecting them to phishing sites after record edits.

title: AdminNeo before 5.9.1 Stored XSS via SVG Upload in FileUploadPlugin
desc: AdminNeo before 5.9.1 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in FileUploadPlugin that allows database users to store script-bearing SVG files by uploading unsanitized content. Attackers can upload a malicious SVG to a *_path field, executing script in the same-origin session of any administrator who opens the file link.

title: AdminNeo before 5.9.1 Authentication Bypass via MS SQL Empty Username
desc: AdminNeo before 5.9.1 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in the sqlsrv-based MS SQL driver that allows unauthenticated attackers to log in by submitting an empty username. Attackers can supply any non-empty password, triggering Windows integrated authentication that grants a full session with the web server identity's SQL Server privileges.

title: Zammad before 7.2.3 Missing Authorization Allows Deletion of Shared Ticket Drafts
desc: Zammad before 7.2.3 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows authenticated customers to delete agents' shared ticket drafts by supplying a shared_draft_id. Attackers can create tickets via POST /api/v1/tickets or reply to accessible tickets referencing a draft id, destroying draft text prepared by agents.

title: Everest Backup <= 2.3.14 - Unauthenticated Arbitrary Plugin Activation via 'page' and 'plugin' POST Parameters
